'''Culen''' is a nobleman and a [[Murandian]] [[Hunter of the Horn]] from [[Minde]]. 

==Appearance==
Culen is tall and lean with a curled mustache.

== Activities ==
[[Matrim Cauthon]] orders him, [[Paers]] and their servant, [[Padry]], out of [[Maerone]] for manhandling [[Olver]], who was sitting on Paers' horse.{{ref/book|6|5}}
